tooltip.greenlantern.ring.hold: Wear it in a Curios ring slot. It binds to whoever carries it first.
tooltip.greenlantern.ring.tree: Open the powers menu to upgrade it with XP.
tooltip.greenlantern.battery.1: Right-click with it in your main hand, or right-click it
tooltip.greenlantern.battery.2: once placed, to fully charge the ring you wear.
ability.greenlantern.ring_root.descripti: Your ring's powers: buy upgrades with XP levels. Suit Up is the bottom slot of the first bar page. Hold Ctrl (or sneak, without KubeJS) and press the first ability key to switch between beam mode and blast mode.
ability.greenlantern.uniform.description: Toggle your corps' suit on or off. Pick the suit and mask in the accessories menu.
ability.greenlantern.skill_health_1.desc: +10 hearts while your ring is charged. Costs 5 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.skill_health_2.desc: Another +10 hearts while your ring is charged. Costs 15 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.skill_combat_1.desc: +4 attack and punch damage while your ring is charged. Costs 5 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.skill_combat_2.desc: Another +4 attack and punch damage. Costs 15 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.skill_charge_1.desc: Your ring holds 1500 charge instead of 1000. Costs 5 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.skill_charge_2.desc: Your ring holds 2000 charge. Costs 15 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.skill_recharge_1.de: Your ring regains 2 charge a second on its own, without a Power Battery. Costs 60 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.skill_recharge_2.de: Your ring regains 4 charge a second on its own, without a Power Battery. Replaces the tier before. Costs 60 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.skill_recharge_3.de: Your ring regains 8 charge a second on its own, without a Power Battery. Replaces the tier before. Costs 60 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.skill_recharge_4.de: Your ring regains 16 charge a second on its own, without a Power Battery. Replaces the tier before. Costs 60 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.skill_flight.descri: Fly on the power of your ring, leaving a trail of light. Flying slowly drains charge. Costs 5 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.blast.description: Blast mode: fire a bolt of hard light where you look. Costs 40 charge.
ability.greenlantern.switch_mode.descrip: Hold Ctrl (or sneak, without KubeJS) and press this key: switch between beam mode (Beam, Construct Wheel) and blast mode (Energy Blast, Scan).
ability.greenlantern.skill_constructs.de: Unlocks the construct wheel and the basics: Sword, Tower Shield and Construct Blocks. Costs 5 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.skill_melee_1.descr: Adds Sword & Shield, Mace and Battle Axe. Costs 8 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.skill_melee_2.descr: Adds Giant Fist and Hammer Slam. Costs 12 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.skill_ranged_1.desc: Adds the Gatling and the Missile Barrage. Costs 8 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.skill_ranged_2.desc: Adds the Cannon. Costs 12 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.skill_defense_1.des: Adds the Barrier Wall and the Cage. Costs 8 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.skill_defense_2.des: Adds the Dome. Costs 12 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.skill_utility_1.des: Adds Scuba Gear and the Mining Drill. Costs 8 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.skill_utility_2.des: Adds the Bridge. Costs 12 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.green.skill_signatu: A speeding train of will smashes through everything in a line 14 blocks ahead. Needs all four construct branches. Costs 20 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.cx_sword.descriptio: A hard-light sword in your hand. Costs 30 charge.
ability.greenlantern.cx_sword_shield.des: A sword in your main hand and a shield in your offhand. Costs 50 charge.
ability.greenlantern.cx_mace.description: A heavy, slow mace that hits very hard. Costs 40 charge.
ability.greenlantern.cx_axe.description: A battle axe that also fells trees and breaks shields. Costs 40 charge.
ability.greenlantern.cx_fist.description: A giant fist punches whatever is in front of you into the air. Costs 100 charge.
ability.greenlantern.cx_slam.description: A giant hammer slams the ground, hurting and launching everything within 6 blocks. Costs 120 charge.
ability.greenlantern.cx_gatling.descript: A gatling gun: hold right-click to fire. Each shot costs 3 charge. Costs 40 charge.
ability.greenlantern.cx_missiles.descrip: Three missiles that explode on impact (they never break blocks). Costs 120 charge.
ability.greenlantern.cx_cannon.descripti: A huge cannonball with a big explosion (it never breaks blocks). Costs 150 charge.
ability.greenlantern.cx_shield.descripti: A shield in your offhand. Block with right-click. Costs 30 charge.
ability.greenlantern.cx_barrier.descript: A 5-wide, 4-high wall of hard light in front of you for 15 seconds. Costs 100 charge.
ability.greenlantern.cx_cage.description: Trap the nearest creature within 12 blocks in a cage. Costs 150 charge.
ability.greenlantern.cx_dome.description: A dome of hard light around you for 15 seconds. Costs 200 charge.
ability.greenlantern.cx_blocks.descripti: 64 hard-light blocks you can place to build with. Costs 60 charge.
ability.greenlantern.cx_scuba.descriptio: A diving helmet and air tank: breathe, see and swim fast underwater. Drains charge slowly. Costs 20 charge.
ability.greenlantern.cx_drill.descriptio: A drill that mines like a netherite pickaxe. Costs 30 charge.
ability.greenlantern.cx_bridge.descripti: A 3-wide bridge of hard light 16 blocks ahead of you for 30 seconds. Costs 80 charge.
A speeding train of will smashes through everything in a line 14 blocks ahead. Costs 200 charge.
ability.greenlantern.constructs.descript: Hold the key and pick a construct with the mouse. Pick a held construct again to dismiss it.
ability.greenlantern.scan.description: Blast mode: scan what you're looking at (up to 24 blocks) for its health and armor; it glows for 10 seconds. Costs 10 charge.
ability.greenlantern.ring_benefits.descr: While charged: 40 hearts and netherite-level armor; no drowning, falling or freezing damage; and the ring translates every language, so villagers trade with you as a Hero of the Village.
ability.greenlantern.green.corps_gift.de: Willpower overcomes fear: you can't be blinded, darkened or made dizzy.
ability.greenlantern.skill_force_field.d: Unlocks a bubble that blocks projectiles, explosions and fire. Costs 5 XP levels.
oath.greenlantern.green.1: In brightest day, in blackest night,
oath.greenlantern.green.2: No evil shall escape my sight.
oath.greenlantern.green.3: Let those who worship evil's might,
oath.greenlantern.green.4: Beware my power... Green Lantern's light!
ability.greenlantern.revoke_ring.descrip: Leaders only: take the ring from the nearest member of your corps.
ability.greenlantern.skill_empowered.des: Within 12 blocks of a Green Lantern your ring recharges fast and you hit harder. Costs 8 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.green.skill_roar.de: Let out a roar that knocks back and weakens everything within 7 blocks. Costs 8 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.green.skill_emerald: Ultimate: a blast of pure will that hurts and launches everything within 8 blocks. Costs 30 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.yellow.skill_signat: A ring of yellow spikes bursts from the ground: everything within 5 blocks is hurt and terrified. Needs all four construct branches. Costs 20 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.yellow.cx_signature: A ring of yellow spikes bursts from the ground: everything within 5 blocks is hurt and terrified. Costs 200 charge.
ability.greenlantern.yellow.corps_gift.d: Hostile mobs within 8 blocks of you are weakened by fear.
oath.greenlantern.yellow.1: In blackest day, in brightest night,
oath.greenlantern.yellow.2: Beware your fears made into light.
oath.greenlantern.yellow.3: Let those who try to stop what's right,
oath.greenlantern.yellow.4: Burn like my power... Sinestro's might!
ability.greenlantern.yellow.skill_inflic: Fill everything within 10 blocks with terror: darkness, slowness and weakness. Costs 8 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.yellow.skill_nightm: Show the nearest creature within 12 blocks its worst fear: blinded, dizzy and sluggish. Costs 12 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.yellow.skill_fear_i: Ultimate: become terror itself, crippling everything within 12 blocks for 15 seconds. Costs 30 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.red.skill_signature: Fast, burning claws of rage (Fire Aspect II). Needs all four construct branches. Costs 20 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.red.cx_signature.de: Fast, burning claws of rage (Fire Aspect II). Costs 60 charge.
ability.greenlantern.red.corps_gift.desc: Your blood is napalm: fire and lava can't burn you, and poison can't touch you.
oath.greenlantern.red.1: With blood and rage of crimson red,
oath.greenlantern.red.2: Ripped from a corpse so freshly dead,
oath.greenlantern.red.4: We'll burn you all... that is your fate!
ability.greenlantern.red.skill_napalm.de: Spew burning blood plasma that sets targets on fire. Costs 8 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.red.skill_rage.desc: Toggle: give in to your rage for Strength II and Speed. Drains charge. Costs 12 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.red.skill_roar.desc: Let out a roar that knocks back and weakens everything within 7 blocks. Costs 16 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.red.skill_blood_rag: Ultimate: a storm of rage that hurts, withers and burns everything within 8 blocks. Costs 30 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.orange.skill_signat: Greedy hands drag every hostile mob within 14 blocks to your feet and weaken them. Needs all four construct branches. Costs 20 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.orange.cx_signature: Greedy hands drag every hostile mob within 14 blocks to your feet and weaken them. Costs 200 charge.
ability.greenlantern.orange.corps_gift.d: Experience orbs within 8 blocks fly to you, and your luck is higher (better loot).
ability.greenlantern.orange.skill_avaric: Passive: you mine much faster while suited up. Costs 5 XP levels.
MINE! Pull every item and experience orb within 16 blocks to you. Costs 8 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.orange.skill_life_d: Steal the life of the nearest creature within 10 blocks to heal yourself. Costs 12 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.orange.skill_greed_: Every mob you defeat while wearing the ring joins your hoard (up to 10). Summon the whole hoard as orange constructs that fight for you for 30 seconds. Costs 16 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.orange.skill_consum: Ultimate: devour the life of everything within 8 blocks and keep it as extra hearts. Costs 30 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.blue.skill_signatur: A dome of hope: you and every player within 5 blocks regenerate and resist damage for 15 seconds. Needs all four construct branches. Costs 20 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.blue.cx_signature.d: A dome of hope: you and every player within 5 blocks regenerate and resist damage for 15 seconds. Costs 250 charge.
oath.greenlantern.blue.1: In fearful day, in raging night,
oath.greenlantern.blue.2: With strong hearts full, our souls ignite,
oath.greenlantern.blue.3: When all seems lost in the War of Light,
oath.greenlantern.blue.4: Look to the stars... for hope burns bright!
ability.greenlantern.blue.skill_hope_aur: Toggle: you and every player within 8 blocks regenerate health. Drains charge. Costs 8 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.blue.skill_rekindle: Restore hope to every player within 12 blocks: instant healing and extra hearts. Costs 12 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.blue.skill_hope_bur: Ultimate: every player within 16 blocks is healed and gains Regeneration and Resistance for 20 seconds. Costs 30 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.violet.skill_signat: A violet crystal spear that seals whatever it hits in crystal for 5 seconds. Needs all four construct branches. Costs 20 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.violet.cx_signature: A violet crystal spear that seals whatever it hits in crystal for 5 seconds. Costs 120 charge.
ability.greenlantern.violet.corps_gift.d: You, the players and the pets around you (8 blocks) slowly regenerate.
oath.greenlantern.violet.1: For hearts long lost and full of fright,
oath.greenlantern.violet.2: For those alone in blackest night,
oath.greenlantern.violet.3: Accept our ring and join our fight,
oath.greenlantern.violet.4: Love conquers all... with violet light!
ability.greenlantern.violet.skill_crysta: Seal the nearest creature within 12 blocks in violet crystal for 8 seconds. Costs 8 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.violet.skill_loves_: Heal every player within 8 blocks and give them Regeneration. Costs 12 XP levels.
Enchant everything within 10 blocks with love so it can barely hurt anyone. Costs 16 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.violet.skill_love_c: Ultimate: fully heal every player within 16 blocks and pacify everything else around you. Costs 30 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.indigo.skill_signat: The Indigo Tribe's staff: long reach, and while you hold it every player within 6 blocks regenerates. Needs all four construct branches. Costs 20 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.indigo.cx_signature: The Indigo Tribe's staff: long reach, and while you hold it every player within 6 blocks regenerates. Costs 60 charge.
ability.greenlantern.indigo.corps_gift.d: Whatever hurts you feels it too: hostile mobs within 5 blocks are weakened.
oath.greenlantern.indigo.2: Ak wo tauva, Ihla wo nauva,
Throw a bolt of indigo light and teleport to wherever it lands. Costs 8 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.indigo.skill_compas: The nearest creature within 12 blocks feels the pain it causes and can barely fight for 10 seconds. Costs 12 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.indigo.skill_healin: Heal every player within 6 blocks. Costs 16 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.indigo.skill_staff_: Ultimate: everything within 12 blocks is overwhelmed by empathy and can barely fight for 15 seconds. Costs 30 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.white.skill_signatu: A shell of pure life: you and every player within 8 blocks gain 12 extra hearts for 30 s. Needs all four construct branches. Costs 20 XP levels.
A shell of pure life: you and every player within 8 blocks gain 12 extra hearts for 30 s. Costs 250 charge.
ability.greenlantern.white.corps_gift.de: You regenerate constantly and never go hungry.
ability.greenlantern.white.skill_life_gr: While crouching: bring the ground around you to life, turning dirt to grass and cobblestone to moss. Costs 8 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.white.skill_life_au: Toggle: you and every player within 10 blocks regenerate health. Drains charge. Costs 12 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.white.skill_entitys: Ultimate: a wave of pure life that heals every living thing within 12 blocks and burns the undead. Costs 30 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.black.skill_signatu: A black hand drags the nearest creature within 12 blocks to you and withers it. Needs all four construct branches. Costs 20 XP levels.
A black hand drags the nearest creature within 12 blocks to you and withers it. Costs 150 charge.
ability.greenlantern.black.corps_gift.de: The dead don't hunger, wither or sicken: no hunger, wither or poison.
oath.greenlantern.black.1: The Blackest Night falls from the skies,
oath.greenlantern.black.2: The darkness grows as all light dies,
oath.greenlantern.black.3: We crave your hearts and your demise,
oath.greenlantern.black.4: By my black hand, the dead shall rise!
ability.greenlantern.black.skill_heart_r: Tear at the heart of the nearest creature within 8 blocks, healing yourself. Costs 8 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.black.skill_death_a: Toggle: everything within 6 blocks slowly withers. Drains charge. Costs 12 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.black.skill_raise_d: Every mob you slay while wearing the ring can rise again (up to 10). Raise them all as Black Lantern revenants that fight for you for 30 seconds. Costs 16 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.black.skill_undying: Passive: while your ring holds at least 500 charge, a killing blow leaves you standing instead. The ring spends all its charge to bring you back. Costs 20 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.black.skill_emotion: Toggle: see every living thing within 32 blocks glowing through walls. Costs 8 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.black.skill_blackes: Ultimate: plunge everything within 12 blocks into death: darkness, withering and pain. Costs 30 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.spectrum.bond.descr: Two rings, two emotions, one light. While you wear two rings, their beams, constructs, force fields, ring light and suit merge into this bar; each ring keeps its own specials page. Merged powers draw on both rings, and the Spectrum Charge bar shows them together. What you buy here stays with you when you take a ring off.
ability.greenlantern.spectrum.skill_shar: Every second, charge flows from the fuller ring into the emptier one (up to 10 a second), keeping the two even. Costs 5 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.spectrum.skill_twin: Recharging either ring at its Power Battery fills both rings. Costs 10 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.spectrum.skill_reso: The two lights feed each other: both rings regain 2 extra charge a second. Costs 15 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.spectrum.skill_dual: +10 hearts while both rings are charged. Costs 8 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.spectrum.skill_twin: +3 attack and punch damage while both rings are charged. Costs 12 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.spectrum.skill_spec: Fly 50% faster on two lights (needs Flight in either ring). Costs 12 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.spectrum.skill_fusi: Fuse both rings' powers in one burst around you; every pair of corps has its own fusion. Costs 125 charge from each ring, every 30 seconds. Costs 8 XP levels.
Spectrum Fusion recharges in 15 seconds and costs 75 from each ring. Costs 15 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.spectrum.skill_over: Ultimate: unleash both rings at once. Everything within 12 blocks takes heavy damage and is thrown into the air, and you gain Strength II, Resistance II and Speed II for 15 seconds. Costs 400 charge from each ring, once a minute. Costs 30 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.spectrum.skill_twin: Constructs cost a quarter less while you wear two rings: both rings share the load. Costs 8 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.spectrum.skill_pris: Your force field also takes the edge off every blow (Resistance II while it's up) and shines in both colors. Needs Force Field in either ring. Costs 12 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.spectrum.skill_twin: The construct wheel also offers your second ring's signature construct. Costs 15 XP levels.
ability.greenlantern.spectrum.cx_sig_1.d: Your first ring's signature construct (or the second's, if only it has one unlocked).
ability.greenlantern.spectrum.cx_sig_2.d: Your second ring's signature construct. Needs Twin Signatures.
tooltip.greenlantern.construct: Hard light: dissolves without its ring
